scope: Reduced elastic model, orientation-preserving signed-junction sector only; no contact/rupture/chemical kinetics; Langevin damping uncalibrated.
embedding: affine x_ref=x0+(xy/ly)*y0; y_ref=y0; references captured before minimization
stress: Conservative affine virtual-work stress: bond/angle virial plus k*sum(dx*dy)/volume; excludes kinetic and thermostat stress.
angular_backend: exact single-rank CPU callback; native angle coefficients intentionally zero
required_postcheck: validate_frame for every saved frame; no accepted inversion
thermal_protocol: remap v + temp/deform bias removal; profile consistency must be checked for each application
